records.name: Petrovietnam Ca Mau Fertilizer Corporation (PVCFC)
records.summary: PVCFC describes its core business as producing, trading, importing, and exporting fertilizers and petrochemical products for agriculture. Its current introduction page presents the company as a provider of crop-nutrition solutions and identifies three owned fertilizer plants.

reportedCombinedCapacity.value: nearly 1.5 million tonnes of fertilizer per year

provenance.factDateNote: The establishment date is explicit. The plant portfolio and combined capacity are current-page claims observed on the retrieval date.

records.name: PVCFC manufacturing footprint
records.summary: PVCFC's 2024 annual-report site identifies three owned manufacturing plants. It reports modern production lines at the Ca Mau plants and records completion of the Korea-Vietnam NPK Plant transfer in 2024.

datedMilestones: 2024-12-25: Ca Mau Urea Plant reached cumulative production of 11 million tonnes of urea
2024: PVCFC completed the transfer of the Korea-Vietnam NPK Plant

provenance.sourceTitle: PVCFC Annual Report 2024: Business lines and operating areas
provenance.factDateNote: Portfolio, production, and transfer statements are reported for fiscal year 2024.

records.name: Ca Mau Urea Plant
records.summary: PVCFC's 2024 annual-report site describes the Ca Mau Urea Plant as a modern production facility capable of manufacturing opaque-granule urea. A separate official technical profile published in 2013 identifies the licensed ammonia, urea, and granulation technologies used by the plant.

attributes.locationReportedIn2013: Khanh An commune, U Minh district, Ca Mau province
attributes.commercialProductMilestone: 2012-01-30: first commercial fertilizer batch reported as dispatched
attributes.operatingMilestoneReportedFor2024: 2024-12-25: cumulative urea production reached 11 million tonnes

provenance.sourceTitle: PVCFC Annual Report 2024: Business lines and operating areas

supplementalSource.title: Nhà máy Đạm Cà Mau: Công nghệ tiên tiến nhất Đông Nam Á

provenance.factDateNote: Capacity, area, location, commissioning milestone, and technology details are historical statements published in 2013; the cumulative-production milestone is reported for 2024.

records.name: Ca Mau NPK Plant
records.summary: PVCFC's 2024 annual-report site reports a 300,000-tonne annual capacity for the Ca Mau NPK Plant and says the production line uses urea-melt technology supplied by Spain's ESPINDESA with major equipment from EU and G7 countries.

attributes.commercialProductionPlanReportedIn2019: Commercial products were planned for Q3 2019

provenance.sourceTitle: PVCFC Annual Report 2024: Business lines and operating areas

supplementalSource.title: NPK Cà Mau gia nhập thị trường phân bón chất lượng cao

provenance.factDateNote: Capacity and technology are repeated on the 2024 annual-report site. The commercial-production timing is preserved only as a plan reported in 2019, not as a current operating claim.

records.name: Korea-Vietnam NPK Plant
records.summary: PVCFC's 2024 annual-report site states that the Korea-Vietnam NPK Plant entered operation in December 2017, has a 360,000-tonne annual design capacity, and uses technology licensed by Spain's Incro. PVCFC reports completing the plant transfer in 2024.

provenance.sourceTitle: PVCFC Annual Report 2024: Business lines and operating areas

supplementalSource.title: Bàn giao Phân bón Hàn-Việt từ Tập đoàn Taekwang-Huchems sang Phân bón Cà Mau

provenance.factDateNote: Commissioning, capacity, technology, and transfer details are reported in the 2024 annual-report materials; location and construction start are from the dated 2024 handover article.

records.name: Ca Mau Fertilizer Research and Development Center
records.summary: PVCFC's dated R&D-center profile describes laboratory, production, and fertilizer-trial capabilities supporting product development and agronomic evaluation. A later official page reports that the Plant Protection Department licensed the center as eligible to conduct fertilizer trials.

capabilitiesReportedIn2017: Fertilizer production and experimental facility in Ca Mau
Fertilizer experimental facility in Can Tho
Cooperative vegetable and industrial-crop fertilizer trial site in Lam Dong
attributes.fertilizerTrialAuthorizationReportedIn20: Licensed by the Plant Protection Department as eligible to conduct fertilizer trials
attributes.researchOutputReportedIn2019: More than 20 research topics or assignments and three products brought to market

provenance.sourceTitle: Đạm Cà Mau khánh thành Trung tâm Nghiên cứu Phát triển

supplementalSource.title: Trung tâm nghiên cứu phát triển Đạm Cà Mau được cấp phép khảo nghiệm phân bón

provenance.factDateNote: Facilities and staffing are historical facts reported in 2017. Authorization and research-output counts are historical facts reported in 2019 and are not asserted as current certifications or totals.

records.name: PVCFC sustainability program
records.summary: PVCFC frames sustainable development around economic, environmental, and social value. Its official sustainability materials identify resource efficiency, digital transformation, technological innovation, greenhouse-gas reduction, environmentally responsible products, and controlled environmental management as active priorities.

attributes.environmentalControlScope: Waste sources are controlled and discharge quality is monitored against permitted standards

provenance.factDateNote: Priorities and management statements were shown on undated current official pages at retrieval. Linked reports are explicitly labeled 2025 and 2024 in their official filenames.
